newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Merrill Lynch seeks broker permit in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch seeks broker permit in Manila.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission's (SEC) brokers and exchange department has recommended the approval of Merrill Lynch's application to operate as a broker and dealer of Philippine securities, SEC documents showed on Thursday.
The commission was set to decide on the recommendation late Thursday.
Merrill Lynch said it will have an authorised capital of 5.26 million pesos.
Merrill Lynch & Co Inc would be the second American firm to set up an equities arm in the Philippines if its application is approved. The first was Citicorp Securities International.
In April, top officials and research staff of Jardine Fleming's Philippine stockbroking arm quit to join Merrill Lynch.
